content.html:
Questions

Before your first visit

Do you take new patients?

Yes — book a check-up online and we will see you within the week.

What does the deposit cover?

A small deposit secures your slot and comes off the final bill. It is fully refundable with 24 hours' notice.

I am nervous about the dentist.

Tell us when you book. We go at your pace, explain everything and can offer sedation for longer treatments.

Do you offer finance?

0% finance over 12 months on treatments above £500, subject to status.
